scope: New contiguous caller context initialization, raw32 settings/owner read relations, and decode of the index handler into an exact new dependency frontier. Existing W5/W6/W7 APIs and normal ranking behavior unchanged.

source_to_transform_to_consumer.transform: In source order: DWORD[S+70]=0; DWORD[S+30]=0; DWORD[S+34]=0; DWORD[S+38]=0; DWORD[S+50]=S+70; DWORD[S+54]=S+80. Preserve all other projection bytes. Pointer addition is modulo 2^32.

new_raw_layout_constraints: Snapshot regions are disjoint stable non-wrapping ranges within the 32-bit address space. The vector and wrapper structs are offline storage, not asserted original layouts.

Address arithmetic wraps at 32 bits; a DWORD load itself must not cross the top of the address space. Unavailable/nonrepresentable reads return the first whole address/width request, not an invented value, machine fault or exception simulation.
An unaligned DWORD may be assembled from adjacent regions. Its little-endian width is exactly four bytes on a 64-bit host.
Selector 2 reads the DWORD at the selector byte itself; do not create independent inconsistent typed fields for this overlapping layout. Selector 255 is not clamped.

No callback effects such as INC are executed by these interior adapters. The existing prefix retains its own increment/FP/CL contract; earlier bypass branches still do not require settings observations.

The initialization API returns only S+00..7F byte state; it does not initialize or dereference S+80. Stable/non-observable intermediate stores and valid destination ranges are required. It models no register result, reachability, heap allocation or full caller frame.
Snapshots use the pinned image's recorded absolute-address domain; runtime relocation/rebasing is not reconstructed.

handler_frontier.entry: All three unsigned JAE edges target 4149EC2D; e8ce06e1ff CALL 412AF300, then cc INT3 at 4149EC32 if it returns. No normal callback epilogue on this fallthrough.
new_chain: 412AF300 pushes 4217783F, calls 41DA8D0D, then INT3 if returned.
4217783F contains exactly the NUL-terminated literal invalid array<T, N> subscript. Literal syntax alone is not proof of source language, type or template use.
41DA8D0D constructs 12 stack bytes via 41DA8E3D, then passes their address and static 42231F3C to 4200A118; INT3 follows if returned.
41DA8E3D calls 41DA88F1, writes 420F2F28 at object+0 and returns with RET 4. 41DA88F1 writes 4205A0E4, zeros object+4/+8, then calls 4200AC82 with two stack pointers.

4200A118 is fully pinned through RET 8. It reads metadata flags, conditionally calls [42529000] and ESI, then supplies stack arguments 0xE06D7363, 1, 3, address-of-three-words to indirect CALL DWORD[421B8F14] at 4200A178. With the pinned first metadata DWORD=0 and unchanged metadata, the optional branches are skipped and the first of three words is 0x19930520.
exact_unresolved: Opaque object construction helper 4200AC82, reached at 41DA8918, including its memory/lifetime effects.
Runtime binding of DWORD[421B8F14] at 4200A178 and downstream dispatch/unwinding/termination or return; static cell bytes do not establish that binding.
Exceptional callback register/stack restoration and caller behavior; INT3 fallthrough is not implemented as an offline throw, a normal return, or an assumed noreturn.
handler_frontier.not_claimed: No runtime provider, exception-class identity, named source ABI, original language/standard or actual failure behavior is inferred from literal strings, code values or helper shapes.

floating_point: No changes to existing arithmetic or ranking. Binary32 round-to-nearest, no FTZ/DAZ/fast-math/contraction; original sNaN/flags/trap/payload exclusions remain. New adapters only copy integer bytes.
tests: Contiguous initialization: byte-for-byte preservation outside six DWORD destinations, raw32 pointer wrap, zero DWORD bits and count-only composition with an independently observed sum. Existing full aggregation test retained; new cases cover every missing load, partial DWORD, indices 0/15/16/17/80000000/FFFFFFFF, raw selectors 0/1/2/255, selector alias, root/manager/owner/pointee addition wrap, segmented unaligned DWORD, top-crossing read rejection, zero/noncanonical flags and direct composition into prefix/ranking.
remaining: Reaching the initializer and maintaining its S/context identity across the caller loop and opaque calls; the origin/content of owner=DWORD[S+80] remains observed, not inferred.
Writers, identity/lifetime and actual runtime contents of 424F639C, root+1012C, manager+2CC, slot selector/flags and owner+4/B0.
Invocation/enumeration, callback exceptional path, complete selector/T+68 consumer, language and full ABI; no full GAP closure or observed equivalence.
